name: today
title: The park office today
subtitle: Arrivals, departures, the site board, cabins and anything that needs a decision

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Unassigned arrivals, double bookings, vans too long, balances owing, overdue deposits, missing invoices, cabins not ready, long-stay accounts behind, meters due.
sections.sql: select reason, ref, guest, detail from v_attention order by reason, ref

sections.title: Arrivals today and tomorrow
sections.sql: select case when v.arrive_on = park_today() then 'today' else 'tomorrow' end as day, v.ref, v.guest, v.site_type as "site type", coalesce(v.site, 'not assigned') as site, v.nights, v.van_length_m as "van (m)", b.eta, v.channel, round(v.balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as balance from v_bookings v join bookings b on b.id = v.id where v.status = 'confirmed' and v.arrive_on between park_today() and park_today() + 1 order by v.arrive_on, v.site nulls first

sections.title: Departures today
sections.sql: select ref, guest, site, round(balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as balance from v_bookings where status = 'checked_in' and depart_on <= park_today() order by site

sections.title: Cabins
sections.note: Cabins with a guest arriving come first.
sections.sql: select site as cabin, status, job, in_house as "in house", arriving, eta from v_site_status where site_kind in ('cabin', 'unit') order by case when job like 'clean now%' then 0 when job like 'check-out%' then 1 when job = 'stayover tidy' then 2 else 3 end, sort

sections.title: Site board tonight
sections.sql: select site, site_type as "site type", area, job as tonight, coalesce(in_house, long_stay, '') as who, arriving from v_site_status order by sort

name: long-stays
title: Long stays
subtitle: Permanent residents, annual vans and seasonal workers: accounts, meters and paperwork

sections.title: Agreements
sections.sql: select ref, kind, guest as occupant, site, starts_on as since, ends_on as ends, days_on_site as "days on site", round(fee_cents / 100.0, 2) as fee, fee_period as per, billed_to as "billed to", round(balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as balance, case when written_agreement and signed_on is not null then 'signed' else 'not signed' end as paperwork, coalesce(nullif(tenancy_law, ''), 'not decided') as law from v_agreements where status = 'active' order by site

sections.title: Behind on their account
sections.sql: select ref, guest as occupant, site, round(balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as owing, days_behind as "days of fees", last_paid_on as "last paid" from v_arrears where status = 'active' order by days_behind desc

sections.title: Meters
sections.sql: select site, guest as occupant, last_read_on as "last read", last_kwh as "last kWh", unbilled_kwh as "unbilled kWh", round(unbilled_cents / 100.0, 2) as unbilled, state from v_meters order by site

sections.title: Record checks
sections.note: Rules and sources in docs/compliance.md. Nothing here is legal advice.
sections.sql: select rule, ref, guest, finding from v_compliance order by rule, ref

name: performance
title: Occupancy, rate and channels
subtitle: The last twelve months and what is on the books

sections.title: Occupancy by month
sections.note: Occupancy counts every site night, casual and long-stay. Casual occupancy leaves out the sites held by long-stay agreements. Average rate is casual revenue per night sold.
sections.sql: select month, case when on_books then 'on the books' else 'actual' end as basis, site_nights as "site nights", casual_nights as "casual nights", held_nights as "long-stay nights", occupancy_pct as "occupancy %", casual_occupancy_pct as "casual occupancy %", round(casual_revenue_cents / 100.0, 2) as "casual revenue", round(average_rate_cents / 100.0, 2) as "average rate" from v_occupancy where casual_nights > 0 or on_books order by month

sections.title: Channels after commission
sections.note: Twelve months of arrivals. Commission uses each channel's rate on the record.
sections.sql: select channel, kind, bookings, nights, round(revenue_cents / 100.0, 2) as revenue, round(commission_cents / 100.0, 2) as commission, round(net_cents / 100.0, 2) as net, avg_lead_days as "avg lead days", cancelled from v_channel_mix order by net_cents desc
